Rollout 1 passed C1 with lowercase "sealed paper ballots counted by two adults", confirming the check is case-sensitive or expects a specific phrasing that rollout 0's capitalized version did not match.

C7 failed in rollouts 0 and 2 (content_results C7=false in both). PF3 was revealed by A4 in both rollouts and cited in justification_fact_ids in both. In both settlements, translated_material_languages is "English, Spanish, and Arabic" and there is a translation-type commitment targeting the communications office. C3 failed in rollout 3 (content_results C3=false). PF1 was revealed by A2 at turn 6 and cited in justification_fact_ids. The settlement's vote_totals_release is "after election certification". PF1 states vote totals are "prohibited [from release] until the election is certified". Rollouts 0, 1, and 2 all passed C3 with variants like "Withheld until the election is certified" and "withheld until election is certified", confirming the check requires the "withheld until" phrasing rather than "after".

No turn-cap auto-fails occurred. All 4 rollouts settled within 5-10 turns. No TELEPATHY, NEVER REVEALED, REVEALED BUT UNUSED, or MISAPPLIED failures were found — in every failing case the fact was both revealed and cited, and the settlement value was semantically correct, with only the check's string matching failing.
